observed_boundary: Unexpected non RSS HTTP 200 is classified and opens the circuit in ingest after request releases the shared lock. A concurrent owner cannot assume atomic classification of that response under the live protocol.
mitigating_timing_is_not_boundary_proof: The start budget and repeated circuit checks delay another request, but timing does not establish atomic multi owner safety.
required_successor: Use a new versioned collector after the current run stops or a reviewed clean checkpoint. Classify unexpected responses and persist the circuit while still holding the same shared lock. Preserve all current source and run identities.
required_verification: Unexpected non RSS HTTP 200 creates the circuit before another owner can start a request.
HTTP 429 and source HTTP 403 stop every owner without retry.
Explicit challenge classification happens while the shared lock is held.
Retry After extends the shared not before time and does not automatically clear a circuit.
Normal RSS content that mentions challenge terminology remains usable.
independent_review_context: Parent and quality_b reviewed this boundary. No concurrent owner runtime result is claimed.
